meta.title: 2019 US domestic departures (BTS) joined to NOAA GHCN-Daily airport weather
meta.source: Kaggle: 2019 Airline Delays w/ Weather and Airport Detail (BTS On-Time Reporting + NOAA GHCN-Daily)
meta.weather_resolution: daily, at the origin airport's weather station

condition_rules.Stormy: thunder (WT03), hail (WT05) or tornado (WT10) recorded that day
condition_rules.Rainy: precipitation ≥ 0.01 in, snowfall reported as 0, no thunder
condition_rules.Foggy: fog (WT01/WT02) recorded, no precipitation or thunder
condition_rules.Clear: none of the above (dry day, no fog or thunder)
condition_rules.unclassified: no precipitation reading, or a wet day at a station that did not report snowfall
